name: ExtractAI: document upload to Google Sheets

parameters.formDescription: Upload passports, Aadhaar cards, PAN cards or tax returns (PDF, PNG or JPG, up to 20 MB each). A local AI model classifies each one, extracts its data and adds a row per document to Google Sheets. Use test documents only.

nodes.name: Google Sheets: append rows
nodes.notes: Off until connected: pick your 'Google Sheets OAuth2 API' credential and the 'ExtractAI results' sheet (row 1 = the column names), then enable this node. While disabled, rows pass straight through.
